observations.content:
Summary: Google DeepMind developed AlphaFold, an AI system that makes state-of-the-art accurate predictions of a protein’s structure from its amino-acid sequence. The system was recognized as a solution to the protein folding problem by the organizers of the CASP14 benchmark in 2020. AlphaFold is able to computationally predict protein structures with unprecedented accuracy and speed, and it has been used by over 3 million researchers from over 190 countries to tackle various scientific problems. The AlphaFold Protein Structure Database, developed by Google DeepMind and EMBL’s European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI), provides open access to over 200 million protein structure predictions.

args.query: AlphaFold paper Nature 2021 developed by DeepMind

observations.content:
Summary: The AlphaFold paper was published in Nature on 15 July 2021, titled "Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold" by DeepMind. The paper detailed the methodology behind AlphaFold and was cited over 40,000 times in scientific journals as of November 2025. The paper was accompanied by the release of the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database, which provided free access to predicted structures of the entire human proteome and 20 other model organisms, totaling over 350,000 structures. The methodology was recognized as a solution to the 50-year-old "protein folding problem" by the organizers of CASP14.

args.query: AlphaFold is a deep learning system developed by DeepMind

observations.content:
Summary: AlphaFold is an artificial intelligence (AI) program developed by DeepMind, a subsidiary of Alphabet, which performs predictions of protein structure using deep learning techniques. It is designed using deep learning techniques and trained on over 170,000 protein structures from the Protein Data Bank. The program uses a form of attention network, a deep learning technique that focuses on having the AI identify parts of a larger problem, then piece it together to obtain the overall solution. The overall training was conducted on processing power between 100 and 200 GPUs. AlphaFold 3 was co-developed by Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs, both subsidiaries of Alphabet, and can predict the structures of protein complexes with DNA, RNA, post-translational modifications and selected ligands and ions.

The program uses a form of attention network "Attention (machine learning)"), a deep learning technique that focuses on having the AI identify parts of a larger problem, then piece it together to obtain the overall solution. The overall training was conducted on processing power between 100 and 200 GPUs. [...] [edit")]

Announced on 8 May 2024, AlphaFold 3 was co-developed by Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs, both subsidiaries of Alphabet. AlphaFold 3 is not limited to proteins, as it can also predict the structures of protein complexes with DNA, RNA, post-translational modifications and selected ligands and ions.
